segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Hello, West Bay Hotel. Can I help you?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Oh, good morning. I'm ringing about your advertisementin the Evening Gazette.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Is that the one for temporary staff?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: That's right.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes. I'm afraid the person who's dealing with that isn't in today, but I can give you the main details if you like.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Yes please. Could you tell me what kind of staff you are looking for?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: We're looking for waiters at the moment.There was one post for a cook, but that's already been taken.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Oh right. Erm, what are the hours of work?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: There are two different shifts - there's a day shift from 7 to 2 and a late shift from 4 till 11.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: And can people choose which one they want to do?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Not normally, because everyonewould choose the day shift I suppose. You alternatefrom one week to another.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Okay. I'm just writing all this down. What about time off?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: You get one day off and I think you can negotiatewhich one you want, it's more or less up to you. But it has to be the same one every week.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Do you know what the rates of pay are?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, I've got them here. You get £5.50 an hour, and that includes a break.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Do I have to go home to eat or ...

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: You don't have to. You can get a meal in the hotel ifyou want to, and there's no charge for it so you might as well.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Oh good. Yes, so let's see. I'd get er, two hundred and twenty one, no, two hundred and thirty one pounds a week?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: You'd also get tips - our guests tend to be quite generous.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Erm, is there a uniform? What about clothes?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, I forgot to mention that. You need to wear a white shirt, just a plain one, and dark trousers. You know, not green or anythinglike that. And we don't supply those.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: That's okay, I've got trousers, I'd just have to buy a couple of shirts. What about anything else? Do I need a waistcoator anything?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: You have to wear a jacket, but the hotel lends you that.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: I see. Er, one last thing - I don't know what the starting date is.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Just a minute, I think it's some time around the end of June. Yes, the 28th, in time for the summer.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: That's great. I'm availablefrom the 10th. Test 41

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Oh good. Well, if you can call again you need to speak to the Service Manager.Her name'sJane Urwin,that's U-R-W-1-N,and she'll probably 08 arrange to meet you.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Okay. And when's the best time to ring?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Could you call tomorrow? Um, she usually starts checkingthe rooms at midday, so beforethen if you can, so she'll have more time to chat. I'll just give you her number becauseshe's got a direct line.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Thanks.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: It's 832 double- .

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: 823 double- ?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Oh, okay. Yes, I'll do that.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: And by the way, she will ask you for a reference,so you might like to be 010 thinking about that. You know,just someonewho knows you and can vouch for yo~.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Yes, no problem.Well, thanks very much for your help.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: You're welcome. Bye.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Bye.
